<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Back to original state. greens=14, player at (37, 20).
# Cannot move LEFT or RIGHT - both cause game over.
# Can click green blocks from current position.
# Need to remove all 14 green blocks.
# Previously clicked 12 safe greens (cols != 19-23), leaving 2 at cols 19-23.
# Let me try clicking ALL 14 greens in one batch, including the "dangerous" ones.

# Green block centers:
# Row 25-29: cols 13-17, 19-23, 25-29, 31-35, 37-41, 43-47, 49-53
# Row 31-35: cols 13-17, 19-23, 25-29, 31-35, 37-41, 43-47, 49-53

# Click all 14 greens:
all_clicks = []
for row in [27, 32]:  # center rows of top and bottom green rows
    for col in [15, 21, 27, 33, 39, 45, 51]:  # center cols of 7 green columns
        all_clicks.append({'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': row, 'col': col})

print(f"Clicking {len(all_clicks)} greens...")
result = action(all_clicks)
print(f"game_over={result.get('game_over')}, board_changed={result.get('board_changed')}")

seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']
greens = len([n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'N'])
purs = len([n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'p' and min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']) < 60])
player = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'b']
pp = None
if player:
    b = player[0]['boundary']
    pp = (min(p[0] for p in b), min(p[1] for p in b))
print(f"After: greens={greens}, purples={purs}, player={pp}")

# List remaining green positions
greens_list = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'N']
print(f"Remaining greens:")
for n in greens_list:
    b = n['boundary']
    minr = min(p[0] for p in b)
    minc = min(p[1] for p in b)
    maxr = max(p[0] for p in b)
    maxc = max(p[1] for p in b)
    print(f"  ({minr},{minc})-({maxr},{maxc})")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
